Prebuilt static libraries for arm64-v8a, used by entry/src/main/cpp/CMakeLists.txt
(tg_media: voice-message Opus/OGG encoding, round-video transcoding, MTProto AES-IGE;
 entry: WebM video stickers).

Rebuild:  ./build_all.sh          (or a single ./build_<lib>.sh)
          OUT_DIR=/some/dir ./build_all.sh  to build elsewhere and compare.
The build is reproducible: the same toolchain and sources give byte-identical archives
(see the checksums below), independent of where the sources are checked out.

Build environment
-----------------
Host:              macOS 26.6 (arm64)
DevEco Studio:     6.1.1
HarmonyOS native:  6.1.1.125 (DevEco Studio sdk/default/openharmony/native)
Compiler:          OHOS (dev) clang version 15.0.4 (llvm-project 99548401bd80576251755b185ab95945e5fe7884)
Target:            aarch64-linux-ohos (musl), OHOS_ARCH=arm64-v8a
CMake / Ninja:     3.28.2 / 1.12.0 (bundled with the native SDK)
Make:              GNU Make 3.81 (libvpx)

Sources
-------
Telegram for iOS   https://github.com/TelegramMessenger/Telegram-iOS
                   commit 6ad963e5b62d354da79040f388ae2b9132fb17b8
  BoringSSL        third-party/boringssl              (Telegram's vendored tree with pre-generated assembly)
  opus 1.5.1       third-party/opus/opus-1.5.1.tar.gz
  libyuv           third-party/libyuv/third_party/libyuv
libvpx v1.13.0     https://github.com/webmproject/libvpx
                   commit e7bfd8b6c230a6824e7fd1efa2378a7322986128 (Telegram-iOS's third-party/libvpx/libvpx submodule)
  libwebm          third_party/libwebm of the same libvpx commit; the mkvparser subset is
                   vendored as source in ../libwebm and compiled by the app's CMakeLists.txt

Configuration
-------------
BoringSSL  CMake Release, target crypto
opus       CMake Release, -DOPUS_BUILD_SHARED_LIBRARY=OFF -DOPUS_PRESUME_NEON=ON -DOPUS_BUILD_TESTING=OFF
           -DOPUS_BUILD_PROGRAMS=OFF -DOPUS_STACK_PROTECTOR=OFF
libyuv     CMake Release, target yuv
libvpx     configure --target=arm64-linux-gcc --enable-static --disable-shared --enable-pic --enable-vp8
           --enable-vp9 --enable-realtime-only --disable-examples --disable-tools --disable-docs
           --disable-unit-tests --disable-webm-io --disable-libyuv --disable-install-docs
           --disable-install-bins --disable-install-srcs --extra-cflags="-O3 -fvisibility=hidden"
All CMake builds use -DCMAKE_POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE=ON and -ffile-prefix-map to strip local paths.
